Frontend loads on all 6 routes with correct data-testids; dashboard KPIs render (5 active wells, 2 critical, 86h, $1.89M), Leaflet map shows well markers, Case Library filter works (4 stuck_pipe rows), Recall Engine shows LIVE EVENT + 5 matches, Assistant streams response in real-time from suggestion click.

GET /api/conflicts: 3 conflicts each with case_id, evidence_a, evidence_b, reason
POST /api/chat SSE: type=delta chunks streamed then type=done terminator received
Dashboard (/): kpi-active-wells, kpi-critical, map-panel, case-row-CASE-001 all present
Case Library (/cases): case-tr-CASE-001 loads; filter-stuck_pipe reduces to 4 rows; case-open-CASE-001 navigates to /cases/CASE-001
Recall Engine (/recall): shows LIVE EVENT header + 5 match-CASE-* items
Evidence Viewer (/evidence): ev-select-CASE-001 present and clickable
Conflict Detection (/conflicts): page loads with conflict content
AI Assistant (/assistant): suggest-0 click triggers streamed response; user message + assistant markdown output rendered live (verified by screenshot)
Sidebar: nav-dashboard, nav-cases, nav-recall, nav-evidence, nav-conflicts, nav-assistant all present
Zero console errors/warnings during frontend session
notes: Case Detail text_content check returned false for keywords immediately after navigation — this was a timing artifact (page fetches on mount, body scraped before render). URL navigation to /cases/CASE-001 succeeded and page did not throw errors. Not a blocker.
